name: developing-ios-apps
description: >- Builds and ships iOS/macOS apps with XcodeGen, SwiftUI and SPM: Xcode build fixes, device deployment, Apple Developer signing/notarization, CI/CD pipelines. Use for XcodeGen project.yml setup, "Library not loaded @rpath" crashes, code-signing errors (Error -25294, adhoc fallback), or Electron notarization failures. Not for TCC permission dialogs (use macos-permissions) or disk cleanup (use macos-cleaner).
